public_contract.constructor: CopilotExecutor(*, command: Sequence[str], original_repository: Path, environment: Mapping[str, str], model: str, effort: str = 'max', supported_efforts: Sequence[str] = (), allowed_tools: Sequence[str] = (), max_output_bytes: int = 2000000)
public_contract.call: run(prompt: str, *, workspace: Path, timeout_seconds: float = 120, cancel: threading.Event | None = None, expected_output: str | None = None) -> dict
public_contract.trust_boundary: Trusted host owns executable argv, credentials, original_repository and model metadata. Never populate these from candidate text or an untrusted HTTP request.
public_contract.effort_precondition: Host supplies supported_efforts verified for the selected model. Missing or incompatible effort returns blocked/unvalidated_model_effort without launch; no fallback.
public_contract.workspace_precondition: Existing absolute real directory outside original repository and user-home ancestry; reject symlinks, hardlinks, special files, inherited .git/.github/.copilot/AGENTS.md configuration and more than 10000 scanned entries. Host owns preparation and prevents concurrent path mutation.
public_contract.tool_policy: Only empty allowed_tools accepted. Nonempty values raise ValueError. Available tools empty; shell/write/url explicitly denied; builtin MCPs disabled; automatic temp access disabled.
public_contract.freshness: New UUID, private HOME/COPILOT_HOME/cache/temp directory per invocation; no resume, continue, custom instructions, remote export or inherited permission overrides.
public_contract.cancellation: Host sets threading.Event; prelaunch cancellation creates no runtime. Running process checked at intervals at most 0.05 seconds. SIGTERM then SIGKILL target process group; leader wait bounded by 0.3 and 1 second. Deadline is process-runtime limit plus bounded settlement, not a hard provider billing limit.
public_contract.payload_policy: No raw prompt, assistant text, reasoning, stdout/stderr, tool arguments or result bodies returned. expected_output comparison remains private. Numeric reasoningTokens is usage, not reasoning content. Injected credential values redacted recursively from public result.
public_contract.exceptions: Invalid configuration/prompt/deadline/expected-output/tool/path inputs raise ValueError; missing or inaccessible filesystem prerequisites may raise OSError. Native launch OSError returns blocked/launch_failed. Process outputs are bounded and malformed JSONL fails closed.

result_keys.elapsed_seconds: float; supervisor monotonic interval, including settlement and parsing
result_keys.resolved_model: str | null; requested model only when usage identity agrees with observed model events
result_keys.resolved_effort: str | null; set on completed result; validated metadata plus accepted flag only
result_keys.exit_code: int | null; actual subprocess return code, never sole success evidence
result_keys.events: list[public event]; raw native objects never exported
result_keys.usage: dict | null; bounded no-symlink usage.json read-back, known finite nonnegative numeric fields only
result_keys.coverage: dict; exact keys jsonl, usage, tool_requests, model_requests, effort, expected_output
result_keys.failure_code: str | null; stable adapter code, no raw diagnostic text
result_keys.runtime_directory: absolute str | null; private caller-owned retained native state

public_event.sequence: int; local stdout line order, not a native producer sequence
public_event.id: str | null; native event ID when exposed
public_event.parent_id: str | null; native parent ID when exposed; ancestor may be outside captured stream
public_event.at: str | null; native timestamp when exposed

assistant.message.tool_requests: list[{tool_call_id: str | null, tool_name: str | null}]; never arguments

coverage.tool_requests: unobserved OR {observed_requests: int, observed_dispatches: int, observed_completions: int, completeness: observed_events_only, nested_commands: unobserved, nonempty_request_schema: fixture_only}

public_contract.completion_semantics: Native procedure completed with expected output when supplied, matching terminal session, positive model call/usage and no recognized refusal/error/tool/write violation. Not task acceptance, candidate improvement, evaluator independence or deployment verification.
public_contract.streaming: CLI streams JSONL into bounded supervisor buffers; public events returned after settlement, not a live callback API. Parent owns event persistence and service lifecycle mapping.

checks: Successful result, unique sessions, exact expected-output check and numeric usage read-back
Exit-0 stderr/structured/text refusals and nonzero exit refuse
Unknown, malformed, deeply nested or incomplete JSONL refuses
Wrong session, wrong model, zero model requests, missing/invalid/symlink usage refuse
Tool requests, dispatches and completions kept distinct; deny-all violations refuse
Deadline, mid-run cancellation and SIGTERM-resistant process settlement
Real descendant receives process-group cancellation and is reaped; PID no longer exists
Output byte ceiling, private HOME/COPILOT_HOME, blocked inherited permission and telemetry variables
Original repository, ancestry, symlink, hardlink and inherited native configuration reject
Raw reasoning, arbitrary payloads and injected credential values absent from returned evidence

limitations: No OS sandbox or independent evaluator isolation; trusted-local host only. Deny-all CLI policy and path validation are not same-user security isolation.
Nonempty tool allowlists deliberately unsupported. No file-editing executor capability claimed.
Only trivial deny-all completion tested natively; nonempty tool request shape tested with fixtures, not live tool invocation.
Active native inference cancellation, escaped process groups, remote request termination and usage flushing during cancellation unverified.
Public stream omits raw private reasoning and arbitrary payloads; retained private CLI state may contain sensitive session material and must not be published.
No provider-internal effort echo, hard billing cap, hidden-request completeness, native producer-sequence guarantee or full parent graph claimed.
Prompt-mode result schema observed with CLI 1.0.83; unfamiliar event types fail closed rather than being guessed.
Parent service integration, immutable evaluator acceptance, HTTP authorization and entire G1 gate are outside writable scope.
Specification architecture read; root docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md was absent. No out-of-scope documentation changed.
